skills.name: Composite - Fish cable through a concealed cavity
skills.description: Route fish tape through concealed wall or ceiling cavities, attach an electrical cable, and pull the cable between access openings.

steps.activity: Determine the cavity_route between the access_openings
Push the fish_tape through the cavity_route to the receiving access opening
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

steps.activity: Wrap the attachment_material around the electrical_cable and fish_tape to join them
steps.category: Wrap around an object and tie

steps.activity: Pull the fish_tape and attached electrical_cable back through the cavity_route
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

steps.activity: Inspect both cable ends and leave sufficient electrical_cable at the access_openings
steps.category: Inspect to check state or find issues

examples: Fish a cable through a ceiling and down a wall cavity
Pull branch-circuit cable between two drywall access openings

skills.name: Composite - Install a junction box
skills.description: Pull a supply cable through the junction box and mount the junction box

steps.activity: Pull the supply cable into the junction box and leave working length
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

steps.activity: Position the junction box against the mounting_surface
Position the mounting_hardware on the junction box
Position the power_tool at the mounting_hardware
Press the trigger of the power_tool
Push the mounting_hardware through the junction box and into the mounting_surface with the power_tool
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

examples: Install a junction box in a wall and pull supply cable into it

skills.name: Composite - Wire and install an electric light fixture
skills.description: Connect the light fixture to the supply cable, position the light and mount it to the junction box or mounting bracket.

steps.activity: Cut and strip the supply cable and light fixture conductor ends with the wire_cutting_tool
Position matching supply and fixture conductors together
Twist the wire connectors from supply cable onto the joined conductors
steps.category: Twist an object using wrist rotation

steps.activity: Position the light fixture against the junction box or mounting bracket
Tighten the mounting_hardware with hand or a hand tool to secure the light fixture to the mount_location
steps.category: Twist an object using wrist rotation

examples: Wire and mount an LED disk light to a ceiling junction box
Connect and secure a ceiling light fixture

skills.name: Composite - Wire and install an electrical receptacle
skills.description: Prepare branch-circuit conductors, connect them to a receptacle, position the device in its box, and secure it with mounting screws.

steps.activity: Inspect and identify the branch conductors for hot, neutral, and ground connections
steps.category: Inspect to check state or find issues

steps.activity: Cut and strip the branch conductors to the required working length with the wire_cutting_tool
Position each branch conductor at its receptacle terminal or wire connector
Rotate wire connectors to secure the branch conductors
Fasten the branch conductors to the receptacle terminals
steps.category: Twist an object using wrist rotation

steps.activity: Position the wired receptacle in the electrical_box
Tighten the mounting screws to secure the receptacle in the electrical box
steps.category: Twist an object using wrist rotation

examples: Wire and mount a replacement duplex receptacle
Install a tab-intact receptacle for continuous power
